name: Heimdall
description: Heimdall is an application dashboard for organising links to your most used websites and web applications.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent Heimdall configuration and application data.

ports.name: HTTP Web UI
ports.description: Heimdall HTTP web interface. Uses port 8082 by default to avoid conflict with the MOS WebUI.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID used by the container for file permissions. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID used by the container for file permissions. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: Allow Internal Requests
variables.description: Allow Heimdall to make requests to private or reserved IP addresses. Enable only when required.
